annotation.title_clean: Redefining Financial Frontiers: Ethical Imperatives and Regulatory Dynamics in Robotic Investment Platforms
annotation.title_en: Redefining Financial Frontiers: Ethical Imperatives and Regulatory Dynamics in Robotic Investment Platforms
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Sharma, M.; Gupta, S.; Kumar T, M.
annotation.summary_en: Conference paper on voice-enabled robo-advisors in investment management, using Design Science Research. It covers client targeting, KYC, onboarding, and regulatory compliance, data privacy and cybersecurity requirements (EU-focused). Robo-advisors are software agents, not physical robots, so the paper has no embodied-AI relevance.
key_provisions_or_claims: Robo-advisors need tailored regulation addressing investor protection, algorithmic accuracy and systemic risk
KYC procedures are essential for compliant, personalised advice
Robust governance frameworks, third-party risk assessments and record-keeping are recommended
Data privacy policies, cybersecurity strategies and cyber insurance are advised
Proposes a conceptual model for a voice-enabled robo-advisor
